# SparsityCeiling

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The theoretical limit at which further reducing spiking activity in a spiking neural network no longer yields proportional energy savings, due to fixed overheads and minimum activation requirements. Defines the practical energy-efficiency boundary for neuromorphic hardware, guiding where activity-accuracy trade-offs are viable in iNEST systems.
